kortit.maaritelma: A property of matter that causes electric interaction; the unit is the coulomb.
The smallest charge that occurs freely.
kortit.kaava_puhe: e is 1.602 times 10 to the power minus 19 coulombs

kortit.maaritelma: The magnitude of the force between two point charges.
kortit.kaava_puhe: F is k times the absolute value of q one times q two, divided by r squared

kortit.maaritelma: The region around a charge in which a force acts on another charge.
kortit.kaava_puhe: E is F divided by q

kortit.maaritelma: The electric potential difference between two points.
kortit.kaava_puhe: U is W divided by q

kortit.maaritelma: The total charge of a closed system stays constant.
The charge that passes a point per unit of time.
kortit.kaava_puhe: I is Q divided by t

kortit.maaritelma: The ability of a component to oppose electric current.
kortit.kaava_puhe: R is U divided by I

kortit.maaritelma: Current is directly proportional to voltage when the resistance is constant.
A property of a material that tells how well it conducts electricity.
A connection in which the current is the same and the voltages add up.
kortit.kaava_puhe: R is R one plus R two

kortit.maaritelma: A connection in which the voltage is the same and the currents add up.
kortit.kaava_puhe: one over R is one over R one plus one over R two

kortit.maaritelma: The sum of the currents flowing into a junction equals the sum of the currents flowing out of it.
The sum of the rises and drops of potential around a closed loop is zero.
The voltage between the terminals of a voltage source when no load is connected.
The work done by the electric current per unit of time.
kortit.kaava_puhe: P is U times I

kortit.maaritelma: The thermal power produced in a resistance.
kortit.kaava_puhe: P is R times I squared

kortit.maaritelma: A component that stores energy in an electric field.
The ability of a capacitor to store charge per unit of voltage.
kortit.kaava_puhe: C is Q divided by U

kortit.maaritelma: A material whose conductivity lies between that of an insulator and a conductor and can be adjusted.
A component that lets current pass in one direction only.
An instrument that measures the electric current through it; it is connected in series and has a very small resistance.
An instrument that measures the voltage between two points; it is connected in parallel and has a very large resistance.
The largest value that the instrument shows at a given selector position; read the value on the smallest range that it fits.
The largest deviation, stated by the manufacturer, by which the reading of a working instrument can differ from the true value.
kortit.kaava_puhe: delta x is p times x plus n times r

kortit.maaritelma: The energy used by a device; at constant power it is the product of power and time.
kortit.kaava_puhe: E is P times t, which is U times I times t

kortit.maaritelma: A unit of energy: the energy used in one hour by a device with a power of $1\,\text{kW}$.
kortit.kaava_puhe: one kilowatt-hour is 3.6 megajoules

kortit.maaritelma: The power marked on a device's rating plate, which tells how fast the device takes electrical energy from the mains.
A single-use voltage source in which chemical energy is converted to electrical energy and the reaction cannot be safely reversed.
A voltage source that can be recharged; charging stores chemical energy in it, not electric charge.
The charge that a fully charged battery can move through a circuit; often given in ampere-hours.
kortit.kaava_puhe: Q is I times t

kortit.maaritelma: The voltage marked on a battery, which is its average voltage during discharge; it is used to calculate the battery's energy.
kortit.kaava_puhe: W is U times Q

kortit.maaritelma: The current driven through a battery by the difference between the charger voltage and the battery's source voltage; the battery charges only when $U_\text{ch} > E$.
kortit.kaava_puhe: I is U ch minus E, all divided by R plus R s

kortit.maaritelma: Energy of a charge that depends on its position in an electric field; it decreases when the field does positive work on the charge.
kortit.kaava_puhe: E p is q times V

kortit.maaritelma: A property of a point in an electric field: the potential energy of a charge per unit of charge; the unit is $1\,\text{V} = 1\,\text{J/C}$.
kortit.kaava_puhe: V is E p divided by q

kortit.maaritelma: The difference between the potentials of two points, that is, the voltage between them; the field does work $qU$ on a charge regardless of the path.
kortit.kaava_puhe: W A B is q times the difference V A minus V B, which is q times U A B

kortit.maaritelma: A surface on which the potential is the same everywhere; the field lines are perpendicular to it.
The energy that a charge with the magnitude of the elementary charge gains when it moves through a potential difference of $1\,\text{V}$.
kortit.kaava_puhe: one electronvolt is 1.602 times 10 to the power minus 19 joules

kortit.maaritelma: A protective device at the start of a circuit that cuts the current before too large a current heats the cable dangerously.
Connection of a device's metal frame to the protective conductor, along which the fault current returns to the supply and trips the fuse.
A protective device that compares the currents in the line and neutral conductors and cuts the current when their difference exceeds the tripping current, usually $30\,\text{mA}$.
The class marked on a device's rating plate that tells how it is protected: I protective earthing, II double insulation, III protective extra-low voltage.
The voltage between a person's feet around a fallen conductor, which grows closer to the point of contact.
A supply with three phase conductors and a neutral conductor; with a balanced load the power is three times that of a single phase.
kortit.kaava_puhe: P is 3 times U times I

kortit.maaritelma: The fuse in each phase conductor of the consumer unit, which limits the current of each phase of the whole house.
A function of a charging station that measures the current in the main fuses and reduces the charging current when other devices are on.
The time it takes to charge a battery at constant power, when the losses of charging are taken into account with an efficiency.
kortit.kaava_puhe: t is W battery divided by the product of eta and P
